findings: engineering/github.py: control_reference accepts the repository default branch as control storage. A configuration mistake can let state-only control commits replace the product tree on trunk. Reject any heads authority equal to the configured default branch before native I/O and add CI coverage.

engineering/github.py: the legacy control_branch alias accepts a fully qualified notes ref. Legacy branch-only workers interpret that value differently. Restrict the legacy alias to branch references; require explicit control_ref for notes and test fail-closed validation.
